checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Realistic wooden cabin among pine trees in dawn lighting
must.why: Realistic log cabin in pine forest with soft low light and glowing windows; dawn-ish.

must.item: Camera advances smoothly toward front door throughout
must.why: Cabin grows steadily larger across frames, door gets closer; cabin is viewed at an angle, though.

must.item: Foreground trees shift relative to cabin, conveying forward movement
must.why: Foreground trunks shift position and parallax is visible.

must.item: Cabin and trees retain consistent shapes, no cuts
must.why: Cabin structure stays consistent across frames; a small window/door detail changes slightly but no cuts.
16:9 frames; silent per the response (audio not verifiable from frames).

faults.what: Camera approaches at an angle toward the side/front corner rather than straight at the front door; the door is on the side wall.
Slight AI-looking details in the stonework and the wall's end window.

summary: A realistic, widescreen log cabin in a pine forest with a smooth push-in and good parallax; the approach is somewhat angled rather than straight at the door.
